newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Persetel buys another European network firm.
newsitem.headline: Persetel buys another European network firm.

text.p: South African information technology firm, Persetel Holdings Ltd, said on Tuesday it has bought a 70 percent stake in ComTech, a leading network systems integrator in Belgium and Luxembourg.
Persetel said in a published announcement that the purchase had taken place through its European subsidiary, Telemation Netzwerk AG, which it bought control of in January.
It said the acquisition price for ComTech will depend on the achievement of the budgeted earnings before tax for the years ending December 31, 1997 and 1998.

The price will be funded from internal cash and represents a historical price earnings multiple of about 10 times. The acquisition, which is effective from December 1, 1996, will not have a material effect on Persetel's earnings.
Persetel said the pruchase is in line with its objectives of expanding Telemation's business in Europe through organic growth and by means of strategic acqusitions.

Shareholders were referred to a cautionary dated February 27 relating to a strategic investment in a Brazilian information technology firm. Persetel said the ComTech acquisition has delayed these negotiations, which are not expected to be finalised before the end of May.
Shareholders were accordingly advised to exercise caution in their sharedealings.
